title: fix: refuse non-text system prompts instead of dropping them
author: NamanSoni78

gist.summary: The shared chat request schema now declares the top-level `system` prompt as an optional string or null. `/v1/chat/completions` and `POST /text` reject arrays, numbers, objects, and booleans with a 400 error naming `system`, instead of returning 200 after silently dropping the instruction. String prompts remain accepted, and null still means no system prompt.

Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings. She should be small-to-medium sized within the scene, sharing the frame with other elements — never oversized or dominating the image. Strictly pixel art style, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream, and dark purple (#110518) details.
